data.name: Baif
data.gender_notes: Baif is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Baif means 'a drop of dew' or 'a little sprout' in Arabic and Urdu. It symbolizes the freshness and renewal of nature, and can be given to a child born in the spring season. The name Baif carries the meaning “Dewdrop” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Baif usually hope their child will grow to embody dewdrop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic numerology, the name Baif holds the number 2, which signifies harmony, balance, and unity. It is believed that children named Baif will possess these qualities and will strive for peace and harmony in their lives.
data.etymology: Baif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dewdrop.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baif total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: بَيْف
in_arabic.meaning: اسم بايف يدل على معنى الفضل و الكرم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بايف مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ب-ي-ف، ويحمل معنى الفضل و الكرم و العطاء. ورد ذكره في بعض الآثار النبوية و الأحاديث الشريفة، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تعبر عن السخاء و الجود. يستخدم الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية كتعبير عن الشخص المعطاء و الكريم.

in_urdu.name: بیف
in_urdu.meaning: بیف کا مطلب ہے فضل اور کرم
in_urdu.long_meaning: بیف نام عربی زبان کے جذر ب-ی-ف سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فضل، کرم اور عطاء۔ یہ نام بعض النبوی روایات اور احادیث شریفہ میں ذکر پایا ہے، اور اسے سخاء اور جود کے اظہار کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے فضل اور کرم کے لئے جانی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बैफ
in_hindi.meaning: बैफ का अर्थ है उपकार और उदारता
in_hindi.long_meaning: बैफ नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल ब-य-फ से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उपकार, उदारता और दान। यह नाम कुछ नबवी कथाओं और पवित्र बातों में पाया जाता है, और इसे उदारता और दान के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने उपकार और उदारता के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: بیف
in_pashto.meaning: بیف د فضل او کرم معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بیف نوم د عربي ژبې د ب-ی-ف ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د فضل، کرم او عطا معنی لري. دا نوم په ځینو نبوي روایاتو او احادیث شریفہ کې موندل شوی دی، او د سخاوت او جود د څرګندولو په توګه ګڼل کیږي. د پښتنو په دود، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خپل فضل او کرم لپاره پېښل شوي دي.

in_english.name: Baif
in_english.meaning: Baif conveys meanings of favor, kindness, and generosity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Baif originates from the Arabic root ب-ی-ف (b-y-f), which signifies favor, kindness, and generosity. Referenced in some prophetic traditions and sacred texts, it symbolizes benevolence and open-handedness. Across Islamic cultures, Baif is used to describe individuals known for their graciousness and charitable nature. The name carries a rich history in Islamic tradition, reflecting values of compassion and magnanimity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Baif holds a significant cultural impact, especially in countries with a rich Islamic heritage. In many Muslim communities, names carry deep cultural and symbolic meanings that reflect the values, traditions, and natural elements of their society. In this case, Baif's association with the renewal and rejuvenation of nature aligns with Islamic teachings that emphasize the importance of preserving the natural world as a gift from Allah. Moreover, the name Baif could represent the hope for a fresh start or new beginning in a child's life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Baif holds symbolic significance for Muslims as an analogy of the sanctity of life. Just as a drop of dew holds the potential to sprout into a mighty tree, each individual has the potential to grow and develop spiritually through the countless trials and tribulations of life. Baif also evokes the concept of tawhid or the oneness of Allah, as every drop of dew ultimately comes from and returns to the Divine Source. Therefore, the name Baif emphasizes the importance of recognizing the divine presence in every aspect of creation and living a life in submission to Allah's will.
